create_logger: create a root logger with file and stream handlers using the create_logger function
create_conditional_formatter: create a ConditionalFormatter that returns raw messages without formatting when the raw attribute is set
configure_file_handler: configure a WatchedFileHandler to write log output to benchpress.log with a custom formatter
configure_stream_handler: configure a StreamHandler that outputs only WARNING level and above messages to stdout
set_log_level: set the root logger level via the LOGLEVEL environment variable defaulting to INFO
